items.headline: Price move coincides with 3 major outage(s) same day
items.detail: Wide intraday MCP spread: 312% of daily average on 2026-07-09, same day as: BELLARY TPS unit 3: 700.0 MW affected; ADANI POWER unit 2: 600.0 MW affected; TORANGALLU TPS unit 3: 300.0 MW affected (~1600 MW total affected capacity). Reduced supply is a plausible contributing driver, alongside demand-side factors -- not asserted as the sole cause.
